ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white/grey) to 55% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) region concentrated at the central peduncle attachment point. The left and right lobes feature high-intensity (white) interior regions with dense, irregular low-intensity (black) mottling and focal spots concentrated heavily along the leading and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity near the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curves extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) are prominent on both the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible traversing the white regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting physical jaggedness at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.
